generator_fit.claim: No audited public source was used to fit the generator.

noaa_duration_context.permitted_interpretation: The NOAA duration distribution may inform a plausibility check for the study's predeclared 300-minute in-distribution time window.
noaa_duration_context.prohibited_interpretation: This is not a fitted rescue-report arrival window, a causal estimate, or rescue-incident ground truth.

uk_noaa_unit_compatibility.reason: NOAA records weather-event durations; UK records attended incidents with financial-year timing and banded/binary responses. Their units and measurement scales are incompatible.
